title: Unsupported actions/github-script runtime
summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve the script, github-token, and result-encoding behavior; check the script against the target release's bundled Octokit.

steps.title: Upgrade github-script
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to actions/github-script@v8 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review github-script inputs
steps.instructions: Compare configured inputs with the target release and update renamed or changed options; confirm the runner meets the release's minimum version.
